### Move When You’re Moved
Author: Lynn Cowell
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-may-11-2016.html
Passage: Exodus 36:3
Points:
- Feeling moved by God to give generously can awaken deep empathy for others in need.
- Fear, doubt, and overthinking often cause people to delay acting on what God prompts them to do.
- The Israelites modeled true generosity by backing up willing hearts with continual, practical action.
- Their daily giving was so abundant that the builders ultimately had more than enough.
- Spiritual blessings come not simply from feeling stirred, but from stepping forward in immediate obedience.
